svg.title: Human LLM Council
svg.desc: Human LLM Council. A personalised human you run on your own hardware: it catches the slop AI agents hand you and sends it back with your feedback. The picture shows the design. Work from AI agents queues on the left. The Council reads each piece first. A stale README preview is ringed in red, stamped "sent back" and returned with the note "this is the old version"; a made-up claim goes back with "where is the source for that number?"; a diff that skips the tests goes back with "I already said this yesterday". Only work that passes reaches the person on the right. Preview: no model is trained yet.
